files.html:
Dochi's Warfare Expanded 0.3.0

Features

  • Vehicle AI tools separated into the DWE addon.
  • Ground vehicle, helicopter, and fixed-wing AI control.
  • Weapon, ammunition, target, faction, crew, and patrol settings.
  • Vehicle combat reactions, including retreat, smoke, and NPC dismounts.
  • Timeline editor for bombing, strafing, vehicle reinforcements, and NPC advances.
  • NPC clone deployment and movement orders for existing NPCs.
  • Per-action deployment times, factions, positions, and lifetimes.
  • Reusable JSON scenarios, coordinate-based calls, and six built-in examples.

Fixes

  • Fixed the NPC support summon-sound crash with earlier DW 0.3.0 builds.
  • Corrected gun-support loading and airborne aiming behavior.
  • Improved bombing release timing and aircraft terrain clearance.
  • Improved editor layout and file-dialog readability.
